title: call.transfer
description: Send the caller to another number, or bring that number into the call. call.transferred says whether it worked, and which mode it was.

CallTransfer.description: Send the caller to another number, or bring that number into the call. call.transferred says whether it worked, and which mode it was.

to.description: The destination number in E.164 form, or a SIP URI.

mode.description: Absent, the runtime picks: cold when the caller is on a SIP leg, warm when they are in a browser. A written conversation has no line and refuses both.
